channel.title: 3ABN Today
channel.desc: Join Danny and Yvonne Shelton with Julia Outkina on 3ABN Today as they reminisce about the miraculous beginnings of 3ABN Russia. Together they share behind-the-scenes stories, God's providence in building the ministry, and inspiring updates of what He is doing today. Don't miss this special program celebrating God's faithfulness from the past to the present!
